question: Which folk dance of Himachal Pradesh was recognised in the Guinness Book of World Records (2015) for having the largest number of participants performing simultaneously at a single venue?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kullu Nati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The folk dance **Kullu Nati** is a traditional dance form originating from the **Kullu district of Himachal Pradesh**.
 
• **Kullu Nati** gained global recognition when it was listed in the **Guinness Book of World Records** in **2015** for having the largest number of participants performing the dance simultaneously at a single venue.
 
• This traditional dance is performed during various festivals and celebrations, including **Dussehra**, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of the Kullu region.
 
• **Kullu Nati** is characterized by its vibrant costumes, rhythmic steps, and lively music, which represent the traditions and customs of the local people in Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The dance is performed in groups, where participants form a circle or a line, moving in rhythm to the beat
